observations: Engine and transmission assembly for a Toyota Corolla (2007-2010) with a 1.6L engine.
The engine is shown from the top and side, with the transmission mounted on the engine.
The engine has significant rust and dirt, indicating it is used.
The engine cover is missing, exposing the valve cover and the top of the engine.
The transmission case shows some yellowing and wear.
A watermark for 'PROVIDE AUTO VENTURE' is visible across the center of both photos.

claims.evidence: The engine is Japanese, but the seller cannot prove it is a specific Japanese-made unit.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may not start or run.
risks.proof: A video of the engine cranking and starting.

risks.risk: The transmission may be seized or have internal leaks.
risks.proof: A video of the transmission shifting through all gears.

risks.risk: The engine may have internal mechanical damage or high compression.
The engine may be a used part from a different vehicle or a non-1.6L model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the valve cover).

proof_requests: Video of the engine cranking and starting.
Video of the transmission shifting through all gears.
Clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the valve cover).
Photo of the engine oil capacity and any service history.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
